name: party
description: A raid frame for every live session on the machine: who is working, who is waiting on you and for how long, per-PR locks so two sessions never act on one PR, and /broadcast to the rest of the party.

nagMinutes.title: Nag after (minutes)
nagMinutes.description: How long another session may wait on you before its bar turns red and party toasts once.

lockMinutes.title: PR lock window (minutes)
lockMinutes.description: A PR another live session merged, closed, commented on, reviewed or edited within this window turns the same action here into a permission prompt.
